valueNote: Adds the Basel ballboy years, the Roland Garros 2009 context from match reports, the Olympic record and the Hall of Fame ceremony details from ATP and Al Jazeera, which the top results do not all carry.
summary: Every cited claim was opened and confirmed except nationality, which cites Britannica (403 today). The rest of the claims are supported by ATP, ITHF, Biography.com, Al Jazeera, AP/NBC, Scroll, Mail & Guardian, Tennis.com, the ITF and the Laver Cup site.
